mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_summary (session_id, user_id, summary_text, key_points, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{summaryText}, #{keyPoints,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE session_summary SET session_id = #{sessionId}, user_id = #{userId}, summary_text = #{summaryText}, key_points = #{keyPoints,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, summary_text, key_points, created_at, updated_at FROM session_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, session_id, user_id, summary_text, key_points, created_at, updated_at FROM session_summary ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, session_id, user_id, summary_text, key_points, created_at, updated_at FROM session_summary ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
